Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO over the 'Chinese spy' affair scandal. The company's finance chief Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO. Nvidia board ousted co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang amid reports of two extramarital affairs, one with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.
Watch Ep 1760 of , where Shekhar Gupta explained the rise of Nvidia, Jensen Huang's close ties with Trump and how the company was caught in an AI cold war. The episode was first published on 21 November, 2025.
